description: Statens energimyndighet: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statens energimyndighet. Coverage: Statens energimyndighet. The listing groups 18 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Andel el av slutlig energianvändning mellan 1970-, TWh och procent; Andel el av slutlig energianvändning från 1970-, TWh och procent; Andel förnybar energi i Sverige enligt förnybarthetsdirektivets beräkn; Produktion av el och fjärrvärme i kraftvärmeverk, procent, 1983. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
